info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Market Data Quant Model-spec
info.description: The Market Data Quant Model Creation API enables financial institutions to develop and deploy quantitative models that leverage market data for analytical purposes. This endpoint allows users to submit details for new models, facilitating advanced analytics and decision-making in trading, risk management, and portfolio optimization. Typical consumers include data scientists and quant analysts who seek to enhance their quantitative capabilities. By integrating this API, organizations can streamline their model development process and improve time-to-market for new analytical tools.

post.summary: Submit a quantitative model for market data processing.
